global.title: This electric aircraft fire truck hits 50 mph in under 20 seconds
global.summary: The “world’s first” electric aircraft fire truck now has a 400 kW fast charger to keep it ready for emergencies at Dallas Love Field Airport.

global.title: Kia sold over 8,000 EV2s in just 3 months
global.summary: Kia’s entry-level electric SUV is already making a name for itself. In its first three full months, Kia sold over 8,000 EV2s as full-scale sales begin.

global.title: Ford recalls nearly 90,000 Mustang Mach-E EVs because part of the trim can fall off
global.summary: Ford is recalling 86,543 Mustang Mach-E models because a piece of glass trim on the rear side could fall off while driving.

global.title: Tesla pays Musk 2.5 million times more than average worker, even as profits drop
global.summary: A new report shows Elon Musk as the highest-compensated CEO, making as much money as 2,522,203 average Tesla workers in 2025. This happened as the Tesla CEO presided over a significant drop in profits which he was largely personally responsible for.

global.title: Volvo wants to help you save money on car insurance
global.summary: It may not be 15 minutes like Geico’s, but Volvo’s new Safety Coach app is designed to help you drive safely while also lowering your car insurance premiums.

global.title: IONNA just beat every major EV fast-charging network
global.summary: IONNA has been operating public fast chargers for less than two years, but EV drivers already rank it higher than every other eligible US fast-charging network.

global.title: Report says Porsche will end Taycan production by 2030, reversing course
global.summary: Porsche will end Taycan production by 2030, claims a German media report. The cancellation is interesting in the light of an interview just last month where the Porsche CEO said the model isn’t going anywhere.
